name: Raytools Single Layer Nozzle — H15
short_description: Single layer copper cutting nozzle with H15 thread for Raytools BM-series heads.
description: Precision-machined single layer nozzle for Raytools BM-series cutting heads with the H15 thread standard. Chrome-free electrolytic copper gives consistent beam alignment and predictable wear. Suited to nitrogen and compressed air cutting of mild steel, stainless and aluminium in thin to medium gauges.
